subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Shared (2-3 sessions a week, at least one text a week): identifies sequence of events and setting; uses the cover to predict

show.line: Stories happen in order. First, next, last. First Bongi wakes up. Next she brushes her teeth. Last she eats breakfast.

rounds.prompt: First Bongi wakes up. Next she brushes her teeth. What happens last?

rounds.story: Sizwe plants a seed. He waters it every day. A green shoot pops up. What happens first?
rounds.praise: Yes! First he plants the seed.

rounds.story: Sizwe plants a seed. He waters it every day. A green shoot pops up. What happens last?
rounds.praise: Yes! Last, the green shoot pops up.

rounds.prompt: Making tea. First boil the water. Next pour it in the cup. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Yes! Then you add the milk.

rounds.prompt: Look at the cover. What do you think happens in this book?
rounds.praise: Yes! The umbrella tells us it will rain.

rounds.prompt: Which picture shows what happens first when you get dressed?

hints: Think about what has to happen before the next thing can.
Listen for first, next and last.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will tell Bongi's morning in order.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: First Bongi eats breakfast. Then she wakes up!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! You cannot eat before you wake up. First she wakes up.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it in order together. Wakes up, brushes teeth, eats breakfast!

parent_line: Can put the events of a short story in order and guess what a book is about from its cover.
